steps.name: Anxiety of Iris (1)
steps.objective: After talking to Minuet in "Adrica", go to [Iris] in "The Frozen World".

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Hello. %s… . I thought I wouldn't see you for a while, but I see you soon. Something's wrong, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like something's going on... , I felt like I had to come back.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I already had something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Iris Find another heart fighting against malice in your heart.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: … I think Iris probably has something he wants to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In that case, I think it would be better to ask Iris directly... . I'll call you once. Because Iris and I are connected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Iris. If you're listening, would you mind coming out and talking for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No matter how long I wait, there is no response.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like we can talk anytime... . Minuet, do you know anything?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I don't know anything!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Really, I really don't know anything else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. all right. Thank you for letting me know. I'll find out what's going on myself.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'll tell you what I know at any time. If there is something new to talk about, we will always tell you about it. Oh, and… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I forgot!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, minuet, are you really pretending that you don’t remember?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: No, I really forgot! I don't remember.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm not important right now, so go find the heart that's fighting hard in the world of Iris's mind!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome, %s… . I waited.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay to stay for a long time now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine now. It's enough to have a brief conversation.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My main body is training hard, and thanks to the help of Adventurer, the evil intent within it is gradually losing its power.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But that doesn't mean you can let down your guard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here because I heard you had something to say.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Goddess Gaia told me to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To be exact, Minuet, the incarnation of the goddess, told me to go… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I guess you were very worried about me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If there's anything you want to talk about, say it all. I'll listen to everything.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll wait. You can take it slow.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No, I don't have time. If I don't hurry, the malice that was barely dormant may reawaken, so I'll hurry.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … Do you remember the friends who traveled with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I remember everything.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. Could you please meet them if possible?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All I have to do is meet you?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, please let me know that Iris is fine.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And I'm sorry... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because Iris's friends are also my friends. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I don't think I'll be able to meet everyone. Some people don't know where it is... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. Please only visit people you can meet at G&DIA.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Levi…. If there’s nothing going on, Levy seems to be in the Elias royal castle, so shall we go there?)

steps.name: Anxiety of Iris (3)
steps.objective: Go to [Princess Black Moon] in “Black Moon Castle”.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s, long time no see.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: What brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's no different... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell about what happened to Iris in the meantime.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, I'm meeting the friends I was with on behalf of Iris.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm glad Zoe and Muwen are with Iris. Thank you for sharing this news.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Iris A lot has happened to you. And, even now, I am in a difficult fate.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I want to help too, but I feel like there's nothing I can do, so I'm just sorry.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: (Levi seems lost in thought for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm sorry that I can only say this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Iris, I also understand everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know any news about other people?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Sorry. I also asked about this before, but I don't know where you are. However, I will let you know as soon as I find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see. Levy, see you later.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Me, %s… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Do you know any news about her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If she… ? Ah, it's Pandora.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes… . Do you know anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I don't know anything right now.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Can I ask one last question?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Who are you going to meet next?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They told me to come and meet someone at Gendia... . Someone comes to mind... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess Black Moon is fine. I saw him not long ago, and he seemed to have recovered greatly in health.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I miss you too after a long time. Then, let’s go to Black Moon Castle… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I hope you go carefully. And please say hello to Iris.

steps.name: Anxiety of Iris (4)
steps.objective: Obtain <Fragment of Memory> in “Dragon Valley”. Then report to [Princess Black Moon] in “Black Moon Castle”.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: How dare you come into this place?!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The princess is aiming her bow at %s. She feels more threatening than when she met her before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good luck, princess. I've become much healthier... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What are you talking about? I was originally healthy. By the way, who are you? Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Anyone who lives in Aoichi can't possibly know me... . Who are you?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Huh, there was a commotion and I said something and it turned out to be you. It's been a while. how have you been doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Seongju, hello.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Thanks to you, I had a good time. Thank you for what you did for the princess... . I've been listening to your activities from afar.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, do you know this person? I came here on my own. The average person wouldn't think of coming here.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Daughter, this person is a horse. This is the person who helped you. In Midgard... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Huh, that's right. Sorry for not knowing you. How should I give thanks?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I was so dazed at the time that I didn't even know who saved me. Please let me know where you are staying and I will appreciate it.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Daughter. I have something to talk with that person for a moment, so would you please leave the table?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Seong, what are you going to talk about?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Isn’t it obvious? Of course it's my daughter's memory.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: When I was looking for the princess for a while because I couldn't see her, Shino, who runs a tavern in Midgard, brought the princess with me.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: As the emptiness in her eyes showed, the princess could not remember anything other than her family and the Black Moon Castle.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I didn't even remember Choen, who I had been with for a long time.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: He literally looked like he had lost his memory. Seeing how perplexed you were, I thought you knew everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Facial expression of loss of memory...?)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Before the princess left Aoichi, one of the villagers told me that it seemed like you had met the princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: There is no need to talk long. It's the result of the princess's choice. My daughter always makes the right choices, so I guess she did then too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord of Seong! I'm sorry for what I said. I have something on my mind, so I will take care of some business and come back quickly.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Hehe, looking at the expression, it looks like there is a good way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, it's not perfect, but maybe it helps a little.

steps.name: Anxiety of Iris (5)
steps.objective: After talking to [Princess Black Moon] in “Black Moon Castle”, go to [Iris] in “Frozen World”.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: How dare you tell me where this place is... uh? This is the person who came last time. Is there something going on in Black Moon Castle again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: My dear daughter, he said he wanted me to see him.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, I love you too, but if you suddenly appear and try to hug me violently... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The princess aims her bow at the castle owner. Just by looking at it, it looks very familiar, probably not once or twice.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Black… . My daughter… My daughter… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I won't be fooled anymore! Because my father’s eye drops are already in my hands.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Sheesh… , I can't help it. Oh, dear daughter, let's not go anywhere and listen to %s's story.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Is this an interesting story for me to hear?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found something that might be helpful. I think the princess should just keep it.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: What is this called? It seems like something full of primal feelings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They say it's a fragment of memory. You can just keep this with you.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Is it okay to just have it? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it will only respond to people who have lost their memories. maybe… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I guess you are also inaccurate.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The princess looks at the fragment of memory with a suspicious expression. Seongju nods and takes the fragment of memory in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (Fragments of memory melt and disappear in the hands of the Black Moon Princess. The princess's expression gradually turns pale as she feels something.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I think I've forgotten something all this time... . I don't know what that is... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (Princess Black Moon's expression returns. She seems to have calmed down to some extent.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yeah. that's right. You were the one who traveled to find Iris. So you found Iris?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Where is Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell about what happened to Iris in the meantime.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yeah? Even so, I will never understand Iris. I don't even want to understand. and… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Princess, do you remember now?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes, father. Not everything, but... . I feel like there was someone I was forgetting.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (The princess is speechless for a moment and tears begin to well up in her eyes.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: %s, you... . Why did you bring me this? Why did I suddenly feel this way?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, father. Do you know who I'm forgetting? yes? I think I know it, but the name is... . I can't remember that name... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Daughter, you might want to get some rest today. Go in first.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: (As the princess enters, the castle lord’s eyes turn lonely.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Now I understand. Why doesn't my daughter remember that child? . I don't know how the kid made the contract, but the price he paid was his daughter's memory... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: That's really harsh. How did it get this far... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Even though it helped me regain some of my daughter's memories... . If you go back, say hello to Iris, no, to the goddess Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elias I went to the royal castle and the Black Moon Castle. I asked everyone to say goodbye and say hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also found a fragment of memory in the Valley of the Dragon and brought it to the princess... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If I had done better, something like that wouldn't have happened to Princess Black Moon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not Iris's fault.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I feel like the harsh fate that has been handed down to this world has made everyone like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Destiny… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something bad just happened. Bad things can happen to everyone... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be weak. Is it fate that I help Iris and that I don't remember certain fragments of memory? That's not true.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Memories of %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . I know well that there is nothing we can do, that the main body is trying, and that it is Iris's weak heart that is talking to me now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, if I only listen to weak sounds, I lose strength. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't properly met the main body of Iris yet, but I'll be going to meet the main body soon, so I hope I can meet it properly then.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I couldn't tell you in advance... . I don't think you'll be able to see the main body until the power is perfected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We are mentally connected, but since we are currently in an unstable state, if we are close to each other, it can become distracting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, there's nothing we can do... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Then I'll come back later. Because I will work hard until then to meet not only Iris's heart but also its body.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, I will do my best too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (Iris's heart is staring at the back of %s as he leaves.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Your heart is truly funny. Is that something you should hide from someone who sacrificed a long time to meet you? Shall I go and talk to you?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's something he shouldn't know. Because that's for him.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Isn't that up to that person to decide?

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Seeing that you are not answering, does it seem like your conscience is being pricked? Then it's my turn to appear again!!

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Let’s see who wins inside the god called Iris!!
